import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl


@triton.jit
def _layernorm_fp16_kernel(X, Y, N, eps, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    row = tl.program_id(0)
    base = X + row * N
    ybase = Y + row * N
    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
    mask = offs < N
    x = tl.load(base + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
    mean = tl.sum(x, axis=0) / N
    x_centered = x - mean
    var = tl.sum(x_centered * x_centered, axis=0) / N
    rstd = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + eps)
    y = x_centered * rstd
    tl.store(ybase + offs, y.to(tl.float16), mask=mask)


def kernel(X):
    N = X.shape[-1]
    Y = torch.empty_like(X)
    BLOCK = triton.next_power_of_2(N)
    grid = (X.numel() // N,)
    _layernorm_fp16_kernel[grid](X, Y, N, 1e-05, BLOCK=BLOCK)
    return Y
